verdict.rationale: Graphite documents several natural-language interfaces. Graphite Chat lets users summarize PRs, ask targeted questions about highlighted code, request fixes, and diagnose failing CI from the PR page. Agents take plain-language descriptions and generate changes or open draft PRs, and GT MCP lets external AI agents drive stacked-PR creation. Missing for 10: NL control over non-code operations such as merge queue, settings, and CLI workflows (the gt CLI is command-based); independent or hands-on corroboration of the NL features.
